data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 0.8m (2016: run-off deviation of GBP 1.1m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2012, 2013 and 2014 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003.

named_events.loss_description: high volume of North America catastrophe losses incurred during the period

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 6.047m, primarily impacting the 2012 to 2015 underwriting years, as calculated from the gross claims development triangle. Separately, a specific favourable run-off deviation (release) of GBP 0.8m was noted for reserve movements on 2012, 2013, and 2014 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year release)
reserve movements on the 2012, 2013 and 2014 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contracts

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of GBP 6.047m is derived from the gross claims development triangle (page 13) as it represents the total gross movement for the syndicate. This figure indicates an overall strengthening, which contradicts a specific statement in Note 8 (page 16) reporting a 'favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 0.8m' related to specific Whole Account Quota Share contracts. The figure from Note 8 is assumed to be a net movement or a partial movement not representative of the total gross syndicate position.
